text: Good evening. I'm looking after my granddaughter Ruby tonight, she's 5. She has a temperature of 38.6. Her breathing is very quick and it's hard work for her. I can see the skin pulling in under her ribs with each breath and every so often she makes a little grunting noise. I've had a good look all over and there's no rash on her anywhere. Her mother is on her way back. I'd like to know what you'd advise I do in the meantime.
